name: goat-slam-words
description: Slam Words · Том үг: fills the screen with one to three giant Mongolian words at a time that slam in, stretch wide or fill in from an outline, over a solid brand colour, black, white or dimmed footage, plus a poster-style stack with red rules, built on HyperFrames. Works with no footage. Renders a 1080x1920 MP4 for Reels/TikTok.
